g.text: Every ray returns on its own line, so the light refocuses in open air at exactly 1x, with no screen.
Three static elements. Nothing scans, spins or moves. Viewing angle 170 deg measured (Yamamoto 2017, DOI 10.11370/isj.56.341).
Unit magnification: image size = source size.
